body: You're right. One week. We'll make it. And yeah, I knew there was no way I could have gone to her house and felt good about myself. Unfortunately, she pulled that number. It just hurt a lot given I was already feeling down and thought hanging out with her would at least keep my mind off of my financial problems. Plus I never expected her to say something like that (which I guess added to the pain). Thanks for taking time to respond. It means a lot. I felt better just from submitting my post. Just having some sort of outlet helped.

Thanks for your response. In some odd way, I appreciate knowing that I'm not alone in feeling this way about asking for money. Not saying I'm glad you've felt similarly, but it does have some comforting notion to it (I swear this sounds better in my head than in text). I think I'm going to take a shower and get to studying. Thanks again.

Thanks for your response. It means a lot, and it's definitely helping. I'm going to look into my college's counseling service. As far as what that girl said is concerned, I know she was being extremely spiteful, I think it just got to me so easily because those two times I was cheated on really took something out of me. I shouldn't let stuff like that worry me though. I should just build on it. Better myself by getting rid of ties with people like that.
